name: AGI Omaha
old_description: AGI produces market-leading grain dryers and aeration equipment for on-farm and commercial applications worldwide.
about:
AGI Omaha operates from Omaha, Nebraska, as part of Ag Growth International (AGI), a global manufacturer of grain handling and storage equipment. The company produces market-grain dryers and aeration systems for on-farm and commercial use worldwide.

The product line centers on two dryer families: the Mixed Flow Grain Dryer, designed to maximize test weight and reduce energy consumption, and the K Series Grain Dryer, a compact, user-friendly unit suited to smaller farm operations. Each dryer section undergoes factory testing with comprehensive quality inspections before shipment. AGI also supplies accessories such as the Dryer Master (DM510) controller, rear platform kits, fuel train upgrades, and cleanout door replacement kits, and operates a parts ordering system for ongoing support.

Customers range from individual farmers to large commercial grain facilities across the globe. The equipment serves the agriculture and grain storage sectors, with dealers and installers available through a searchable network. Brands under the AGI umbrella include Airlanco, Batco, Hutchinson, Mayrath, Westeel, Westfield, Wheatheart, and dozens of others, reflecting a broad portfolio of grain handling solutions.

AGI emphasizes hands-on technical dryer service training and experienced technical support to help customers get the most from their equipment. The company states that factory testing and quality inspections on every dryer section, combined with accessible dealer support, are central to its approach.

name: ALL SKY ENERGY, LLC.
old_description: ALL SKY ENERGY SPECIALIZES IN SOLAR PV INSTALLATIONS & EV CHARGING STATIONS
about:
All Sky Energy, LLC is based in Baraboo, Wisconsin. The company specializes in solar photovoltaic installations and electric vehicle charging stations. Founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed, though testimonials reference Lisa and Keith as key contacts.

The firm designs and installs grid-connected, off-grid, and battery-backup solar systems for residential, commercial, and utility-scale projects. Installations include ground-mount, canopy, and roof-mount configurations. A certified master electrician with over 20 years of residential and commercial experience oversees the work. The company also provides solar operations and maintenance (O&M) services for utility solar farms, commercial arrays, and off-grid sites, and offers free estimates with site surveys.

Customers span residential homeowners, commercial businesses, and utility operators. The company participates in programs such as Focus on Energy and the Grow Solar Sauk County initiative, helping clients access residential renewable energy tax credits and business energy investment tax credits (ITC). Solar O&M is offered to utility solar farms, commercial solar installations, and off-grid locations.

All Sky Energy emphasizes the use of quality components and the expertise of its certified master electrician as differentiators. The business was built on a commitment to tailored system design and careful installation, with a willingness to refer clients to other reputable providers when a project falls outside its service area.

name: AMSOIL Distribution Center
old_description: Delivery options and speeds may vary for different locations.
about:
AMSOIL Distribution Center is located in Orlando, Florida, where it operates as a regional distribution hub for AMSOIL products. The facility serves as a corporate office, a distribution point, and a product pick-up location for wholesale account holders. The founding year and ownership structure for this specific site are not publicly disclosed.

The center’s primary activities revolve around customer service, technical support, and order fulfillment. Staff handle product inquiries, account management, and warranty assistance, while also providing free product catalogs and merchandise information. The site does not engage in manufacturing; instead, it manages logistics, shipping, tax compliance, and product returns for the AMSOIL product line.

The distribution center caters to a mix of automotive, industrial, and retail customers who rely on AMSOIL lubricants, filters, and accessories. Wholesale account holders have the option to collect orders directly from the Orlando location, while other orders are shipped according to standard delivery schedules that vary by destination.

The operation emphasizes accessible technical assistance and streamlined order processing as part of AMSOIL’s broader distribution network, aiming to reduce lead times for customers in the Florida region.

name: AVNA - Formerly OKAY Industries (Berlin, CT)
old_description: Driven by innovation. Known for collaboration. We deliver excellence that brings medical devices to market faster.
about:
AVNA, formerly OKAY Industries, is headquartered in Berlin, Connecticut. The company traces its engineering and manufacturing roots back over 100 years and has served the medical technology sector for nearly 50 years. Ownership structure and founding year are not publicly disclosed.

AVNA produces precision components and assemblies for medical devices. Its capabilities include precision stamping and machining, Swiss turning with Accu-LaserSwiss™, laser processing (welding, marking, cutting, surface treatment), metal tube forming, plastic injection molding and overmolding, automated and robotic assembly, and value-added finishing. Operations span three facilities in the United States and Costa Rica totaling more than 226,000 square feet. The company also runs NexTech Labs for prototyping and process development and a LaserWorks R&D lab.

The company serves medical device OEMs across several clinical areas: cardiac and neurostimulator implantable devices; laparoscopic, endoscopic, and arthroscopic instruments; surgical stapling, cutting blades, knives, and scissors; ENT turbinate and shaver blades; and ligation instrument components and assemblies. An automotive cold-rolled part case study is also noted.

AVNA emphasizes its collaborative engineering approach, including design for manufacturability and design for automation, supported by dedicated laser process engineers. It states that its integrated processes, quality controls, and production capabilities are built to meet demanding design challenges and accelerate time to market.

AZ Auto Parts LLC operates from a suite on West Lake Mead Boulevard in North Las Vegas, Nevada. The company has accumulated over a decade of experience in the automotive aftermarket, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been made public.

The business functions as a retailer specializing in automotive collision parts, stocking the most common replacement components for vehicle repair. Its model emphasizes immediate availability: the company states that the majority of its catalog is kept on hand or can be sourced with a turnaround of one to two days.

The primary customer base consists of collision repair shops and related automotive service providers in the Las Vegas area seeking rapid access to standard body panels, lighting, and trim pieces. The company does not list specific OEM or fleet accounts in its public materials.

AZ Auto Parts highlights its customer service and the speed of its fulfillment as its main differentiators, positioning itself as a reliable local source for shops that need common collision parts without extended lead times.

name: Abaco Systems, Inc.
old_description: And heat, and vibration, and humidity and salt fog and just about whatever else you have.
about:
Abaco Systems, Inc. is headquartered in Huntsville, Alabama. The company has supported the U.S. Army for more than 30 years, providing embedded, rugged hardware solutions for key programs.

Abaco designs and manufactures rugged embedded computing hardware for aerospace and defense applications. Its product portfolio includes single-board computers such as the SBC3513 and SBC3901 series, VPX modules like the VPX3UX311 RTM, video processing units including the NVA2000xX and NVA500, and graphics boards such as the VP891 and VP231. The company also offers product lifecycle management services and publishes detailed hardware reference manuals for each product line.

The company serves defense and military aviation customers, with capabilities across air programs for rotorcraft, fixed-wing aircraft, and unmanned aerial vehicles. Its hardware has been deployed in U.S. Army programs for decades, and it participates in defense modernization efforts through collaborations such as the LatentAI initiative.

Abaco emphasizes ruggedization for extreme environments, highlighting resistance to heat, vibration, humidity, and salt fog. The company states that all its products share three core characteristics, though those are not detailed in public materials, and positions its offerings as purpose-built for harsh operational conditions.
